title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with adequate nutrients to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy, helping to build balanced and nutritious meals.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following international pantry staples are excellent choices for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, supporting digestive health and reducing the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, supporting the development of bones and teeth for the baby.
- Lentils: rich in iron, supporting the production of red blood cells and reducing the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, supporting the development of the baby's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, supporting the development of the body and reducing the risk of nutritional deficiencies.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, supporting the immune system and reducing the risk of disease.

## Building Balanced Meals for Pregnancy
To build balanced and nutritious meals, pregnant women can combine these international pantry staples with traditional Vietnamese foods. For example:
- Breakfast: oats with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: lentils with leafy greens and citrus.
- Dinner: low-mercury salmon with eggs and leafy greens.

## Food Safety Considerations
Pregnant women need to be mindful of food safety when preparing and consuming these international pantry staples. Some important considerations include:
- Cooking food thoroughly to reduce the risk of food poisoning.
- Avoiding foods high in mercury, such as shark and swordfish.
- Washing leafy greens and fruits thoroughly before consumption.

## Conclusion
International pantry staples can be a great addition to a pregnant woman's diet, providing essential nutrients and supporting the health and well-being of both mother and baby.
